CS5489.title_zh: CS5489 · 机器学习双语学习卡
CS5489.short_description: CS5489 · 双语课程卡 / Bilingual course cards. 先读讲义与微课，再用卡片复习。Notes & guide: https://crazyshout.github.io/micro-course/guide.html?course=CS5489

sections.title_zh: 这套牌组怎样配合学习
sections.body_zh: 适合从基础开始学习机器学习、需要用英文答题的学习者。整讲讲义沿老师顺序梳理内容，微课通过例子解释概念之间的联系；学懂后，用这里的双语题答回忆概念、公式条件和解题步骤。
sections.body_en: For learners building machine-learning foundations and preparing to answer in English. Course notes follow the instructor’s sequence; micro-lessons explain connections through examples. Use the bilingual cards afterward to recall concepts, formula assumptions and solution steps.

sections.body_zh: 当前材料包括Lecture1–5、Tutorial1–4及Assignment1–2相关方法。Extra Resources保留后续历史主题及深化内容，供按需预习。CNN完整内容等尚未由当前课件覆盖；QE范围以学校要求为准。
sections.body_en: Current materials include Lectures 1–5, Tutorials 1–4 and methods for Assignments 1–2. Extra Resources contains historical topics and extensions for optional preparation. Full CNN coverage is still historical; the school defines the QE scope.

sections.body_zh: 从对应Lecture的讲义或微课开始，跟着完整例题计算，再独立做一道变式。文末列出少量首轮卡，按卡号在Markji查找；不熟悉的基础可先点补课入口。网页用于阅读与预览，Markji负责正式复习，两边进度独立。
sections.body_en: Start with the relevant lecture notes or micro-lesson, work through an example, then solve a variation independently. Find the small first-pass set in Markji by card ID. Use prerequisite links when needed. The website supports reading and previews; Markji handles review, with separate progress.

sections.body_zh: 评分、截止日期和提交清单在网站的“课程信息”栏。牌组中的来源与微课链接可帮助你回查定义、推导和原题。
sections.body_en: Find grading, deadlines and submission checklists in Course information. Card sources and lesson links lead back to definitions, derivations and original questions.

sections.body_zh: 先遮住答案，说出核心结论，再解释理由。计算题写出关键中间步骤；中文用于理解，随后尝试用英文独立回答。若只记得句子却解释不清，回到对应例题重做；编程题则需要实际运行。
sections.body_en: Hide the answer, recall the conclusion and explain why. Show key steps in calculations. Use Chinese to understand, then try an independent English answer. If you remember a sentence but cannot explain it, redo its worked example; programming tasks require running code.

CS5222.title_zh: CS5222 · 计算机网络双语学习卡
CS5222.short_description: CS5222 · 双语课程卡 / Bilingual course cards. 先读讲义与微课，再用卡片复习。Notes & guide: https://crazyshout.github.io/micro-course/guide.html?course=CS5222

sections.title_zh: 这套牌组怎样配合学习
sections.body_zh: 通过网页访问、文件传输等情境理解网络，再用双语卡片复习术语、计算与机制。整讲讲义按老师Chapter顺序展开，微课跟踪分组、比特、ACK、窗口与路由状态，帮助你把各层联系起来。
sections.body_en: Learn networking through web requests and file transfers, then review terminology, calculations and mechanisms with bilingual cards. Notes follow the instructor’s chapters; micro-lessons trace packets, bits, ACKs, windows and routing state to connect the layers.

sections.body_zh: 当前材料包括Chapter1–2、Chapter3的part1–2、Tutorial1–5和Assignment1。Extra Resources保留后续传输、网络层与链路层等历史预习；完整连接管理与拥塞控制仍待当前课件。QE范围以学校要求为准。
sections.body_en: Current materials include Chapters 1–2, Chapter 3 parts 1–2, Tutorials 1–5 and Assignment 1. Extra Resources contains historical material on later transport, network and link-layer topics. Full connection management and congestion control await current slides; the school defines QE scope.

sections.body_zh: 从对应Chapter的讲义或微课开始，画出路径或事件时间轴，再做配套Tutorial。文末列出少量首轮卡，按卡号在Markji查找。网页用于阅读和预览，正式复习在Markji完成，两边进度独立。
sections.body_en: Start with the chapter notes or a micro-lesson, draw the path or event timeline, then attempt its tutorial. Find the small first-pass card set in Markji by ID. The website supports reading and previews; formal review happens in Markji, with separate progress.

sections.body_zh: 评分、截止日期、提交清单与研究报告要求在网站的“课程信息”栏。卡片中的来源与微课链接帮助你回查协议约定、原图和计算过程。
sections.body_en: Find grading, deadlines, submission checklists and research-report requirements in Course information. Card sources and lesson links help recover protocol assumptions, figures and calculations.

sections.body_zh: 读清图、单位和完成事件，再动笔计算。回答机制题时说明谁发送什么、接收后怎样改变状态。改一个条件重算，并尝试用英文解释；遇到bit/byte、二进制或概率困难，可就近打开基础补课。
sections.body_en: Read the figure, units and completion event before calculating. For mechanisms, explain who sends what and how receipt changes state. Recalculate after changing a condition, then explain in English. Use nearby foundation links for bits/bytes, binary or probability.
